source_summary: Tall ink-and-color winter landscape with layered mist, leafless brush and trees, eroded banks, shallow water, a small scholar figure, and distant wooded slopes. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: upper_left_mist_wash
motifs.description: Pale horizontal atmospheric wash in the upper-left and central sky area, with soft gray-green ink bands and diffuse mist edges; isolate only the empty mist field, excluding the inscription at upper right.
must_preserve: subtle uneven ink pooling without paper border or calligraphy

motifs.name: mid_distance_reed_islets
motifs.description: Scattered low winter reed and shrub clumps emerging from broad pale mist bands across the middle distance.
must_preserve: soft gray shadow washes beneath reed patches

motifs.name: left_foreground_winter_grove
motifs.description: Dense group of tall leafless trees on the left foreground slope, including trunks, exposed roots, and interlaced bare branches.
must_preserve: small dry grass strokes along the ground

motifs.name: hidden_hut_and_inner_trees
motifs.description: Small partially obscured hut or pavilion structure set behind the foreground trees, with straight architectural lines and surrounding slender trunks.
must_preserve: tiny rectilinear roof and wall geometry
vertical tree trunks in front of the structure
delicate architectural lines partly hidden by branches

motifs.name: right_receding_tree_slope
motifs.description: Right-side midground slope with a screen of slim vertical trees, dark shrub masses, and terraced grassy contours receding into the distance.
must_preserve: curving contour lines of the slope

motifs.name: eroded_stream_bank
motifs.description: Cut earthen bank beside the stream in the lower middle-right, with exposed vertical faces, ridges, grasses, and pale water edge.
must_preserve: broken ink outline along the bank lip
gray wash shadows under the ledge

motifs.name: foreground_rock_outcrop
motifs.description: Large dark rocky outcrop and low bank at the bottom center-left, with layered brush-textured stone forms and tufts of water grass.
must_preserve: small reed tufts around the base

motifs.name: solitary_scholar_with_staff
motifs.description: Single robed scholar standing on the pale stream bank at lower right, holding a slender staff, with blue-gray outer robe and light inner garment.
must_preserve: delicate contour lines of sleeves and hem
standing posture facing left across the water

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
